stem: What was the most likely result of the publication of images such as this 1906 political cartoon?

options.label: F
options.text: The government passed the Sherman Antitrust Act.

options.label: G
options.text: Private companies refused to import foreign foods.

options.label: H
options.text: The government passed the Pure Food and Drug Act.

options.label: J
options.text: Labor unions protested unsafe working conditions.

AN AWFUL CASE OF JUNE ODORS
By Maurice Ketten.
